name: XTR 9-speed 12–34T cassette
weight_description: Manufacturer-listed 1999 reference: 255 g for the XTR CS-M952 nine-speed 12–34T cassette. The exact model and ap tooth sequence are identified in the same manual’s XTR service table.

technical_document.title: Shimano 1999 STI technical manual, PDF page 57 / printed page 56: XTR cassette feature explicitly publishes 255 g for the 12–34T nine-speed reference

sources.title: Shimano 1999 STI technical manual, PDF page 57 / printed page 56: XTR cassette feature explicitly publishes 255 g for the 12–34T nine-speed reference

Shimano 1999 STI technical manual, PDF page 91 / printed page 90: XTR service table identifies the cassette as CS-M952, nine-speed ap 12–34T; the rear-derailleur M953 code is not used as a cassette alias
